verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance automation platform, so HR-synced onboarding and offboarding tracking is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack does not document HR integrations, per-employee onboarding or offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking, or proof of deprovisioning for leavers. Several items are only adjacent and earn no credit: periodic access reviews, Thoropass's own user-access management and admin 'Onboarding Mode' for setting up the platform, and policy acknowledgment.
